question: Can a balanced network of rings grow by one ring at a time and keep every contact persistent, and do the uniform refinements of the Platonic networks keep it?

public_inputs.run: run.py in this folder, 16 worker processes.
public_inputs.family: Seeds: loops of 3 to 6 rings, two rings sharing 3 to 5 contacts, the five Platonic networks, the 3 x 3 and 4 x 4 square tori, the genus-2 network of 16 rings from GL(2,3). Every attachment of one new ring by m = 1, 2, 3 contacts, and m = 4 on seeds of at most 8 rings. The truncations and rectifications of the five Platonic networks.
public_inputs.exactness: Exact: return counts are read by following A^k e_c until the next vector lies in the span of the earlier ones; no lag cutoff.

forbidden_inputs: Changing the seeds or contact counts after seeing results
primary_observable: Attachments after which every contact keeps even return counts, by seed and number of contacts; the refinements' verdicts.
cheapest_meaningful_control: grow_lib's exact test agrees with loopnet_lib.odd_returns on 1,276 random attachments (scratch), and GROW-NET-20261108-001A proves the one- and two-contact cases.
decision_or_followup_rule: H1, frozen: no attachment by 1 or 2 contacts keeps every contact persistent, and none by 3 or 4 on a seed of more than 4 rings. H2, frozen: every truncation and rectification of a Platonic network loses persistence except the rectified tetrahedron (the octahedron). If both hold they support the obstruction to growing one ring at a time and to refining the sphere; a counterexample is recorded as a growth step that works.
stop_rule: Stop when every attachment and refinement of the family has its verdict.
nonclaims: Exploratory: one growth step from these seeds only.
feasibility_disclosure: Before freezing, a scratch run of the same attachments (m = 4 capped at 20,001 per seed) found persistence kept only from the loop of 3 rings, two rings sharing 3 contacts and the tetrahedron, and the refinements as in H2. So H1 and H2 are not blind predictions. run.py --pilot timed one seed and printed no verdicts.
